about: Two cells are one step apart when an origin looked at both, so a world is a graph of its lookings and distance is the walk between them.
It is a metric: zero on a cell against itself, symmetric, and never broken by a third cell.
Across a desert of cells no looking crosses there is no number at all — that is the horizon, and one claim that speaks at both sides collapses it.

cases.name: two cities of a hundred and sixty and eighty across a desert of a hundred and sixty lone cells
